The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

Hippocratic AI's Polaris model powers discharge outreach and nurse support tools deployed across many hospital systems, each hospital bringing its own EHR, telephony and scheduling systems into the integration.

Even where each hospital's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same patient and discharge record.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what a generative AI health company Hippocratic AI's size spends on technology.
